Automation Beyond AI

AI is great, but not when token costs crush your profitability. Sometimes the right infrastructure and automation are just more effective. As a marketing leader who has held many operational and infrastructure responsibilities, I know when to build and when to buy.

For years I've worked inside critical tools like HubSpot and Salesforce, designing and running workflows and automation for marketing, sales, and revenue operations. This means I know when something needs to be built with AI or can be done more cost-effectively and efficiently elsewhere.

I've built systems that have transformed sales follow-up on critical accounts from days to minutes, improved lead quality with better qualifying workflows, and reactivated countless cold leads with responsive nurture programs. Where some teams think they're saving time with AI by building systems they inevitably have to waste time babysitting, I know how to build infrastructure you can build your business on.
